answers.core:
Godot's current structure is such that the instance is managed by the operating system, as a process.

This would allow multiple godot instances in one process, each with their own settings.

## Other uses

Scenarios that could benefit from this have been discussed in the past:

* https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1473
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/7213
answers.workaround: No, this scenario needs some changes to the Godot Engine.

title: Make Godot instantiable so it can run multiple projects within a single process
